title: Protect deduplication state with a durable store
description: Deduplicates payment webhooks using an in-memory set on one API instance.
issue_title: Deduplication state is local and non-durable
issue_description: Duplicate delivery protection fails across restarts or horizontally scaled instances.
issue_suggestion: Move deduplication state to a shared durable store with an expiry policy.

title: Use an outbox for cache invalidation events
description: Updates product data and publishes an invalidation event in the same request path.
code:
def update_product(product):
    db.save(product)
    event_bus.publish('product_updated', product.id)
    return product
issue_title: Event delivery is not tied to the database commit
issue_description: If the publish fails or races the commit, caches may remain stale or consumers may see inconsistent state.
issue_suggestion: Persist the invalidation event in an outbox and publish it after commit.

title: Avoid synchronous permissions recomputation on writes
description: Recomputes every team membership projection when one role changes.
issue_title: A local change triggers an unbounded synchronous recomputation
issue_description: Large teams or organizations can make a single write path catastrophically slow.
issue_suggestion: Scope the recomputation incrementally or offload projection rebuild to background processing.

title: Bound retries in saga orchestration
description: Retries a shipping reservation step until it eventually succeeds.
issue_description: Infinite retries can pin workers indefinitely and hide stuck workflows.
issue_suggestion: Use bounded retries with backoff and a compensating terminal state.

title: Partition event streams by tenant boundary
description: Publishes all customer events to one shared stream without tenant metadata.
issue_title: Tenant isolation is not represented in the stream design
issue_description: Multi-tenant event processing becomes harder to isolate, replay, or secure without tenant scoping.
issue_suggestion: Carry tenant identity explicitly or partition streams by tenant boundary where needed.

title: Decouple export generation from the download request
description: Builds a large CSV report synchronously inside the download endpoint.
code:
def export_report(filters):
    rows = query_all_rows(filters)
    csv_data = render_csv(rows)
    return csv_data
issue_title: Long-running report generation sits on the request path
issue_description: Large exports can exhaust request timeouts and tie up app workers.
issue_suggestion: Convert export generation into an async job with later download retrieval.

title: Keep read-replica lag out of correctness checks
description: Creates an order in the primary DB and checks for it immediately in a replica-backed read.
issue_title: Replica lag is treated as a correctness failure
issue_description: Eventually consistent read replicas should not be used for immediate write-after-read invariants.
issue_suggestion: Use the primary for correctness checks or design around eventual consistency explicitly.

title: Replace full scans in cron with cursor-based progression
description: Nightly cron reads every user to find expiring subscriptions.
issue_title: The batch job performs a full-table scan each run
issue_description: As data grows, blanket scans become expensive and harder to schedule safely.
issue_suggestion: Use indexed cursors or precomputed eligibility windows instead of rescanning the whole table.

title: Manage distributed locks with renewable leases
description: Uses a lock row with no expiry while processing an import job.
issue_title: The lock can become orphaned on worker failure
issue_description: Without lease expiry and renewal, crashed workers may block the workflow indefinitely.
issue_suggestion: Use expiring leases with heartbeats or a lock service that handles renewal safely.

title: Separate hot-path storage from archival retention
description: Stores ten years of audit payloads in the same hot table used for current dashboards.
code: CREATE TABLE audit_log (id, created_at, actor_id, payload_json);
issue_title: Hot operational queries and long-term retention share one storage layout
issue_description: Large cold history can hurt performance and operating cost for current reads.
issue_suggestion: Split hot operational access from archival storage with a retention lifecycle.
